card.name: Linking words before cancer type names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "including", "and" or "for" right before a named tumor or cancer type, e.g. lymphoma, ALCL, rhabdomyosarcoma. Also "Non" before "-Hodgkin" or "seminomatous".

modes.label: Including a list of cancers
modes.description: "including" or "and" opens a list of specific tumor or lymphoma types.
modes.example: Approximately half the cases were lymphomas,<< including>> Hodgkin's and non-Hodg

modes.label: Dosage heading for a cancer
modes.description: "for" in a heading naming the cancer being treated.

modes.label: Non before cancer name
modes.description: "Non" starting a cancer name like non-Hodgkin or nonseminomatous.
modes.example: 2.4 Recommended Dosage for Metastatic<< Non>>seminomatous Testicular Cancer The

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward words like "primitive" or "germ", as in primitive or germ cell tumors.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a specific cancer type is named, such as "including" before a lymphoma.
